subject: Klopp's Germany smash Netherlands 5-0 to top Nations League group, Wirtz scores twice
title: Klopp's Germany smash Netherlands

lines.vo: Germany needed to beat the Netherlands by five goals. So they did.
Five-nil in Berlin. Germany top their Nations League group. The Dutch can count Germany's goals on one hand. Just.
Florian Wirtz scored twice. A long-range strike in the sixtieth minute, then a volley in the seventy-first.
Germany scored three goals in eleven minutes. The Dutch defence must have gone for coffee.
Nagelsmann was dismissed after a World Cup exit to Paraguay. Jurgen Klopp took over in August.
Klopp says this result will quiet the doubters for three or four months. Honest man. He even gave them a date.
It was also Germany's last game in an Adidas kit. Five-nil is a proper send-off.
